table.name: TLGNC_SHIPPINGPOINT
table.description: A Shippingpoints is the starting point of an order, in all types of orders. They are associated with a supply plant and its type defines what loading facilities are present at the shippingpoints. The material is loaded at one of the loading points which belong to a shipping point (see tlgnc_loadingpoint). Normally these shippingpoints are known to SAP as well (see SAP_SHIPPINGPOINT_NO), but for certain rail orders some Logon-only shippingpoints were introduced to have a consistent order model in Logon: from=shippingpoint, to=shipto.

column.name: PLANT_CD
column.description: FK tlgnr_plant_bs. The supply or production plant which owns this shipping point.

column.name: SAP_SHIPPINGPOINT_NO
column.description: The SAP Identifier of the shipping point of a plant. (plant_cd, sap_shippingpoint_no) is the unique identifier. The SAP values for shippingpoints are not kept as reference data in Logon. For Logon-only shippingpoints, this number is made-up, and starts with a '#'.

column.name: KNOWN_ALSO_IN_SAP_FLAG
column.description: Whether this is a shippingpoint which exists also in SAP (identified by plant_cd, sap_shippingpoint_no), or created independently in Logon only. false=only in Logon, needed to represent starting points for certain rail orders. When an order starting at such a shippingpoint is sent to SAP, Logon instead uses the data from SEND_SAP_SHIPPINGPOINT_ID or - if null - from LOCATED_AT_SHIPPINGPOINT_ID of the order's shipto.

column.name: SHIPPINGPOINT_NAME
column.description: The name of the shipping point.

column.name: SHIPPPOINT_TYPE_CD
column.description: FK tlgnr_shipppoint_type_bs. The type of the shipping point: 0=Road, 1=Rail, 2=Container Terminal, 3=Bimodal Truck (FVL), 4=Rail Supplier, 5=Rail Repair and 6=Rail External/Return.

column.name: SAP_SHIPPING_COND_CD
column.description: FK tlgnr_sap_shipping_cond_bs. The Shipping Condition which will be sent to SAP for an order starting at this shipping point. E.g. E1=Truck, S1=SBB, S3=Mobile Silos, S4=RhB. The application does not check contradicting values with Shipping Point Types; the shipping condition does not hold any logic for LOGON.

column.name: STORAGE_LOCATION
column.description: The default Storage Location where materials are maintained at this shippingpoint. Value is used when exporting the order to SAP if no material-specific storage location is found in tlgnc_mat_shippingpoint. The material must be 'stockable' however, i.e. having material_package_cd.can_have_storage_location _flag = 1, else, the storage location is always empty/null.

column.name: RAILWAY_STATION_ID
column.description: FK tlgnc_railway_station. The railway station of the shipping point if the shipping point is a railway station.

column.name: RAILWAY_STATION_LOADING_POINT
column.description: Railway station loading point. Currently used values are only NUM2. value is ignored by LOGON, but sent back to SAP in order export interface, dep_station_loading_point, which is only NUM2.

column.name: SBB_CUSTOMER_NUMBER
column.description: SBB Customer Number, will be send to SBB.

column.name: WEIGH_SYSTEM_SP_CD
column.description: FK tlgnr_weigh_system_sp_bs. The weighing system type for this shippingpoint.

column.name: LDS_SERVER
column.description: The identifier of the LDS server at this shippingpoint. Several shippingpoints can be served by the same LDS server; several terminals are connected to one server, see tlgnc_loadingpoint.weigh_system_loadingpoint_no (unique per server). The name here is used to lookup the actual IP address/DNS name via the tlgnr_config keys wsclient.<infix from tlgnr_weigh_system_sp_bs>.host.name.<lds_server> and thus becomes independent of the deployment/instance of LOGON.

column.name: SHIPPINGPOINT_COMMENT
column.description: A comment about the shipping point.

column.name: COORD_LAT
column.description: Latitude coordinate of the shipping point.

column.name: COORD_LON
column.description: Longitude coordinate of the shipping point.

column.name: COORD_FIX_FLAG
column.description: Whether coordinations are fix. 0=the coordinates will be updated with the next incoming information from a PDA. Editing the coordinates in the User Interface is still possible.

column.name: GEOFENCE_RADIUS
column.description: The geofence radius of the shipping point.

column.name: FVL_MIX_SHIPTO_PER_WAGON_FLAG
column.description: Has meaning only for shippingpoints of type Bimodal/FVL, for other type it is ignored. If the flag is set to true, the shippingpoint allows the usage of a single wagon by bimodal truck-orders for different shiptos. Normally this is forbidden, because the individual loads in the trucks are not precisely known (just the total net load in the wagon). However, if a scale is nearby and is used, the exact weight for the trucks can be determined accurately even when the wagon is only partially unloaded.

column.name: SEND_SAP_SHIPPINGPOINT_ID
column.description: FK tlgnc_shippingpoint. An alternative shippingpoint which should be used in the SAP Order Export interface. This is only relevant for certain rail orders, where shippingpoints are in use which are not known in SAP (Rail Supplier, Rail Repair, Rail External/Return).

column.name: UOM_CD
column.description: FK tlgnr_uom_bs. Unit of Measurement. The costs are expressed per 1 UOM. If a cost is specified, UOM_CD is mandatory. Note, that it is impossible to express material-independent default handling costs for a single shippingpoint but for two different UOM, because shippingpoint_id is PK!

column.name: VAR_HANDLING_COST_MAT
column.description: Current variable handling cost of material (per 1 UOM), material-independent. These are costs caused when handling (loading/unloading) a material at a plant. If the handling costs are material dependent, they are set in tlgnc_mat_shippingpoint and have priority over the value here. Handling costs are caused at each plant which is involved, i.e. production and supply plant (if different). The UOM is implicitely the same as for the material received from SAP.

column.name: FUTURE_VAR_HANDLING_COST_MAT
column.description: Future variable handling cost of material (per 1 UOM).

column.name: FUTURE_VALID_FROM_DAT
column.description: Validity start date of future_var_handling_cost_mat. Current costs are valid until before future_valid_from_dat. Moving 'future' into 'current' and updating the future_valid_from_dat is a manual task, done once per year. Logon compares delivery date of order with this date and decides which cost is to be used.

column.name: CURRENCY_CD
column.description: FK tlgnr_currency_bs. Currency in which the handling costs caused by this Shippingpoint are expressed. Exchange rates in tlgnc_currency_exch_rate must be respected when adding costs of various sources in one order_item.

column.name: RAIL_ARRIVAL_WARNING_MIN
column.description: Used for FVL only. If the linked rail order for a bimodal truck order has not arrived RAIL_ARRIVAL_WARINIG_MIN minutes before the planned load time of the assignment, then a warnign is displayed in truck dispatching

column.name: TIMEZONE_CD
column.description: Timezone assigned to the shipping point entity
